submitted.rationale: Photocurrent climbed steadily as Cr went up and Fe went down while V stayed at about 0.42–0.49: 7e-8 A at Cr0.10 (idx 0), 2e-7 A at Cr0.25 (idx 15), and 3.8e-7 A at Cr0.37/Fe0.21/V0.42 (idx 137). Idx 137 is the highest measured value. XRD showed the same main phase (strong peak at Q≈2.78) in idx 0, 15 and 9, so the gain comes from composition within that phase, not a phase change.
